Seminar Title:

Investigation of Machinability of Inconel 925 Superalloy

Seminar Type:

Department:

Mechanical Engineering

Speaker Name:

Abhisek Panigrahi ( Rollno : 518me1023)

Speaker Type:

Venue:

Seminar Hall, Mechanical Engineering Department

Date and Time:

29 Oct 2026 10.30AM

Contact:

Kalipada Maity

Abstract:

This synopsis presents an integrated experimental, numerical and data-driven investigation of the machining performance of Inconel 925, a precipitation-hardened nickel-based superalloy. Turning tests were conducted with PVD-coated carbide tools subjected to cryogenic treatment followed by tempering, and the effects of treatment, cutting parameters and machining environment were examined under dry, flood and minimum-quantity-lubrication (MQL) conditions. For MQL, a hybrid mixture of Al2O3 and CuO nanoparticles dispersed in rice-bran oil was prepared to improve cooling and lubrication at the tool&ndashworkpiece interface. Cutting force, surface roughness and tool wear were evaluated as the principal responses, with material-removal behavior considered in the multi-response assessment. DEFORM-3D simulations were used to represent the thermomechanical cutting process and to examine the predictive capability of finite-element analysis against experimental observations. Taguchi-assisted Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) was applied to identify balanced machining conditions, while Response Surface Methodology (RSM) was used to model factor effects, interactions and response trade-offs. In addition, Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) models were developed to capture nonlinear relationships and predict machining responses. The thesis concludes that suitable cryogenic treatment and tempering improve PVD-tool performance, while the machining environment&mdashparticularly hybrid-nanofluid MQL&mdashplays a major role in reducing cutting force, surface roughness and tool wear. The integrated GRA&ndashRSM&ndashDEFORM-3D&ndashANFIS framework supports efficient, sustainable and reliable optimization of difficult-to-machine Inconel 925 components.
Keywords: Inconel 925 PVD-coated tools cryogenic treatment tempering dry/flood/MQL machining Al2O3&ndashCuO nanofluid DEFORM-3D GRA RSM ANFIS
